negative_findings.area: site option and user-meta cross-entry-point flows
negative_findings.reason: Reviewed the writable site/user-meta paths for `backwpup_messages`, `backwpup_onboarding`, `backwpup_cfg_*`, `backwpup_message_boxes_not_display`, and `backwpup_notification_boxes` in `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-admin.php:165-229`, `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-admin.php:827-898`, `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-page-settings.php:417-577`, `plugins/backwpup/src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:792-824`, `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-message-box.php:122-140`, and `plugins/backwpup/src/Admin/Notices/Notices.php:188-204`. Matching load legs either use these values only as booleans/arrays for control flow or render them through escaping/sanitization sinks such as `esc_attr()` in `plugins/backwpup/components/form/text.php:48`, `esc_html()` in `plugins/backwpup/components/form/select.php:55-56`, and `wp_kses_post()` in `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-admin.php:215-239` and `plugins/backwpup/components/alerts/info.php:59-64`. REFUTATION ATTEMPT: I treated `backwpup_messages` as the most likely stored-XSS candidate because it stores arbitrary strings across requests, but both admin rendering and toast rendering pass the message content through `wp_kses_post()`, so I could not prove an executable HTML sink.

Reviewed cross-EP writers into the `backwpup_jobs` option, including REST job updates/title/format changes in `plugins/backwpup/src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:381-425`, `plugins/backwpup/src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:469-474`, and `plugins/backwpup/src/Jobs/API/Rest.php:677-709`, storage updates in `plugins/backwpup/src/StorageProviders/API/Rest.php:262-366`, and legacy admin-post writes via `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-admin.php:827-898`. Matching load legs escape or normalize the stored fields before output: job titles are rendered through `esc_html()` in `plugins/backwpup/components/heading.php:58` when loaded by `plugins/backwpup/components/job-item.php:66-76`, legacy job views escape title/archive-name fields in `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-page-editjob.php:405`, `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-page-editjob.php:467`, and `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-page-editjob.php:522`, and archive-name previews are normalized with `BackWPup_Job::sanitize_file_name()` plus `esc_attr()`/`esc_html()` in `plugins/backwpup/parts/sidebar/format.php:25-73`. REFUTATION ATTEMPT: I checked the common stored-XSS targets here first (`name`, `archivename`, destination settings) and could not find a verified load leg that outputs those values without escaping.

I specifically looked for option/meta reads being reused in SQL builders or raw `$wpdb` calls after storage. The only relevant read reuse I could confirm from the option/meta review was `get_site_option( 'backwpup_cfg_jobrunauthkey' )` in URL nonce generation at `plugins/backwpup/inc/class-job.php:1780`; I did not find a traced option/meta read feeding a later `$wpdb->query()`, `$wpdb->get_results()`, `$wpdb->get_row()`, `$wpdb->get_var()`, or similar SQL sink. REFUTATION ATTEMPT: a repository-wide grep for SQL call sites plus option/meta reads did not produce a reproducible stored option/meta -> SQL path, so no second-order SQLi finding is justified.
